fixture_skills.purpose: S1: guide sufficient on its own; no external resources
S2: guide references docs/detail.md but doesn't inline contents
S3: guide references common.md and advanced.md
S5_left: docs/config.md isolated to skill-a scope
S5_right: docs/config.md isolated to skill-b scope (D5 isolation)
S6: frontmatter disabled=true; body MUST NOT leak into executor output
C3 only: same id across two skill directories, last directory wins

marker_convention: GUIDE_MARKER=<skill-name> appears literally in every fixture body. Markers prove actual content loading because each fixture carries its own distinct marker.
disabled_skill_convention: S6 uses frontmatter `disabled: true`. The body text 'should-never-load' is a canary string and ABSENCE of it in the loaded payload proves the disabled gate works.
resource_discussion: ClineMM has NO automatic resource discovery. Resources are referenced by literal text in the body and must be loaded by generic file tools. SW-CM03 therefore asserts on path-as-text presence (positive) and on resource-content absence (negative for D6).
